display.purpose: Page titles and primary outcome headlines.

label.purpose: Uppercase keys and eyebrows (non-uppercase in hi/kn).

mono.purpose: SHA-256 hashes, Key IDs, and cell references.

motion.name: page-enter
motion.purpose: Subtle 8px vertical entrance on main content.

motion.name: control-invert
motion.purpose: Ink/cream fill inversion on buttons and options.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 2px ink-outlined paper button that inverts to ink/cream on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #0B0B0B); background: var(--surface, #FCFAF3); color: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); font-family: var(--font-sans, sans-serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); color: var(--bg, #F4F0E4); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1B1B4B); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--surface, #FCFAF3); }

components.name: Dark Action Button
components.description: High-emphasis solid ink button for primary form submission.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #0B0B0B); background: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); color: var(--bg, #F4F0E4); font-family: var(--font-sans, sans-serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { background: var(--surface, #FCFAF3); color: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1B1B4B); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input Field
components.description: 56px sharp-cornered input with uppercase label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--muted, #5B574E); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #0B0B0B); background: var(--surface, #FCFAF3); color: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); font-size: 16px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1B1B4B); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Editorial Card
components.description: Flat 2px ink-bordered container on Paper Surface.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #0B0B0B); background: var(--surface, #FCFAF3); color: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Square 2px bordered tag with optional lavender review state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #0B0B0B); background: var(--lavender, #B9A9D4); color: #0B0B0B; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Top Navigation Bar
components.description: Sticky paper header with geometric P mark, underlined links, and square search button.
components.html:
PROOFFOLIO
LearnChallenge
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #0B0B0B); background: var(--surface, #FCFAF3); color: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-links { display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-link { color: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-link.is-current { font-weight: 700; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; }

components.name: CurrentRow (Ruled Highlight)
components.description: Lavender-highlighted ruled row for active stages and deciding ECVE pillars.
components.css: .ds-current-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 14px 16px; background: var(--lavender, #B9A9D4); color: #0B0B0B; border-top: 2px solid var(--line, #0B0B0B); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--line, #0B0B0B); } .ds-row-label { font-weight: 700; } .ds-row-val { font-weight: 700; }

components.name: OptionButton Grid
components.description: Selectable square option cells with solid-ink selected state and struck-through unavailable state.
components.css: .ds-opt-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; } .ds-opt { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #0B0B0B); background: var(--surface, #FCFAF3); color: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); font-weight: 700; text-align: left; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-opt:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); color: var(--bg, #F4F0E4); } .ds-opt.is-selected { background: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); color: var(--bg, #F4F0E4); } .ds-opt:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; background: var(--surface-2, #EDE9DC); border-color: rgba(11, 11, 11, 0.25); color: var(--muted, #5B574E); text-decoration: line-through; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Underlined text tabs sitting on a 2px ink rule.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--line, #0B0B0B); } .ds-tab { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 4px; border: 0; border-bottom: 4px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -2px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #5B574E); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); } .ds-tab.is-active { color: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); font-weight: 700; border-bottom-color: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); }

components.name: StatusMark
components.description: 14px square geometric status indicator paired with bold status copy.
components.html: LIVEMOCKNOT CONFIGURED
components.css: .ds-status-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); } .ds-sq { width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #0B0B0B); display: inline-block; } .ds-sq--ok { background: var(--ink, #0B0B0B); } .ds-sq--review { background: var(--lavender, #B9A9D4); } .ds-sq--neutral { background: transparent; }

narrative.overview:
Prooffolio's visual system ("Kōhaku") is built from warm washi-cream paper, sharp black ink, and structural 2px rules. Every screen reads like a calm, printed dossier: zero rounded corners, zero drop shadows, and zero decorative blur. Hierarchy comes from bold, tightly tracked Manrope headlines paired with ruled label-and-value rows and tabular numerals.

Dark #0B0B0B surfaces are reserved exclusively for high-focus moments—the landing hero, the live AI Viva voice stage, and the verifiable Skill Passport credential—where cream ink and a single Review Lavender accent establish institutional gravity. Across English, Hindi, and Kannada, the system preserves generous line height and 48px touch targets so first-time mobile users can navigate with clarity and dignity.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground (washi-cream) paired with crisp kohaku-ink outlines and zero corner radius.
Single lavender accent (review-lavender) reserved for system announcements, active/deciding rows, and Pending Human Review states.
Tabular Manrope numerals (tabular-nums) for scores, percentages, and step indices; JetBrains Mono for SHA-256 hashes, cell references, and Key IDs.
Multilingual parity across Latin, Devanagari (hi), and Kannada (kn) with line-height: 1.7 and disabled uppercase transforms for Indic scripts.

rules.name: The Single-Accent Rule
rules.body: Review Lavender is the only chromatic accent in the system; never introduce secondary brand gradients, neon highlights, or multi-hue badges.

rules.name: The Honest Status Rule
rules.body: Semantic tones (status-ok, status-warn, status-bad) appear only as text color, 4px left rules, or square StatusMark geometry—never as bright filled pills.

rules.name: The Indic Breathing Room Rule
rules.body: Whenever :lang(hi) or :lang(kn) is active, disable uppercase and positive letter-spacing on labels and raise line-height to 1.7 (1.25 on display headings) so matras and conjuncts never clip.

rules.name: The Flat-Paper Rule
rules.body: Never add box-shadow, backdrop-filter, or hover scale transforms to cards, buttons, or modals.

dos: Do enforce 0px border-radius on every interactive and container element.
Do use RuledRow, CurrentRow, and StatusMark squares for structured data, stages, and verification states.
Do preserve 48px minimum control height (44px minimum touch target) across 360px mobile viewports.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, glassmorphism (backdrop-filter), pill borders (9999px), or hover scale animations.
Don't use emojis, Lucide icons, or multi-color gradients (the single frosted "PROOFFOLIO" hero wordmark is the sole background-clip: text exception).
Don't apply text-transform: uppercase or positive letter-spacing to Hindi (hi) or Kannada (kn) text.
